name: Heat
use_when: Use when the crew's jobs should leave a trail: the louder the work, the more the law and the rivals come knocking.

entangle_low: old friends call in a favour: someone the crew owes needs a job done now, no pay
a rival crew moves on the crew's turf while it is busy elsewhere
a quiet week: someone useful offers help, a tip or a cheap deal
entangle_mid: the watch leans on the neighbourhood: a contact is picked up and asked about the crew
word gets out: someone wants a cut of the take to keep quiet
a debt comes due: a backer wants their share sooner than agreed
entangle_high: a raid: the law hits a place the crew uses; get out or lose what is there
a crew member is named: pay off the law, hand someone over, or go to ground
the law closes in: an arrest is coming; pay (wanted + 3 coin), hand someone over, or run
